report_name: Ransomware Attacks Surge to 2026 High; Qilin Group Most Active

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: Emerged as the most prolific ransomware group in August 2026, responsible for 15% of total incidents (164 attacks). It operates a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model and uses double-extortion tactics. High-profile targets included the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives and the Manchester Airports Group.

threat_actors.name: Aurora
threat_actors.description: An emerging Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) group active since April 2026. Their attack chain involves exploiting VPNs and using stolen credentials for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Used by the Qilin ransomware group to encrypt victim data as part of their double-extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Used by the Qilin ransomware group to exfiltrate victim data before encryption, threatening to leak it on their dark web site.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The Aurora RaaS group exploits vulnerabilities in VPNs for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The Aurora RaaS group uses stolen credentials for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups were observed using tools like vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, preventing system recovery.

malware.name: Qilin ransomware
malware.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) payload deployed by the Qilin group, which uses double-extortion tactics.

malware.name: Aurora ransomware
malware.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) payload deployed by the emerging Aurora group.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by ransomware operators to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description: A legitimate tool monitored for suspicious usage as a precursor to ransomware attacks.

tools.name: wmic
tools.description: A legitimate tool monitored for suspicious usage as a precursor to ransomware attacks.

identities.name: U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF)
identities.description: A high-profile U.S. government agency targeted by the Qilin ransomware group in August 2026.

identities.name: Manchester Airports Group
identities.description: A high-profile victim targeted by the Qilin ransomware group in August 2026.

identities.name: Industrial Sector
identities.description: The most heavily targeted sector in August 2026, accounting for 31% (329) of all ransomware attacks.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Dark Web Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by the Qilin group to threaten the release of exfiltrated victim data as part of their double-extortion tactics.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b1a9c8d-4e5f-4a3b-9c8d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/ransomware/ransomware-activity-hits-2026-high-as-industrial-sector-bears-31-of-attacks-and-qilin-dominates/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-28
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware tactic to inhibit system recovery.
